**A new lid for tissue box covers that goes in like a bayonet: pressed in, slid along, and it clicks shut on flat ledges by the cover's corners.** Print the cover again for it. The web version has it too: <https://rickusinggithub.github.io/vaseinator/>.

### Download & run (Windows)
1. Download **Vaseinator.exe** below and run it. It is one file: nothing to unzip or install. SHA256SUMS.txt holds its checksum.
2. The app isn't code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may say "Windows protected your PC". Click **More info → Run anyway**.

No Python needed. To run from source on any OS, see the README. Or just use it in your browser: <https://rickusinggithub.github.io/vaseinator/>.

### Changed in 1.17.0
- **Why the 1.16 lid wasn't good enough.** Any ledge inside a cover printed upside down has to slope, so a lid hanging on ledges pushes the thin walls apart under a box of tissues. The new lid hangs on **flat** faces instead, and pushes on the walls only along them, never out.
- **The cover has four catches** inside its long sides, by the corners, where the wall is stiff. Each is a **tooth**, a **pocket** under a short **bridge** - a flat ledge, printed as a real bridge - and a **stop**. Nothing needs supports.
- **The lid** has four **ears** on its long edges and four **springs**: tongues cut in the frame, printed flat so they bend the strong way, each with a post that presses on the box of tissues.
  - Put the box of tissues in the cover and turn them over. **Lay the lid in** against one end, posts down, leaving a gap of about 10 mm at the end its **arrow** points to. It drops in only the right way round.
  - **Press it in** about 3 mm and **slide it along till it clicks**: the ears pass under the teeth and spring up into the pockets. Now it can't slide back unless it is pressed in first, and the box of tissues' weight presses the other way.
  - To change the tissues, **press it in and slide it back**.
- **Lid grip** (Gentle, Snug, Firm) now sets how firmly the springs press: a step firmer if the lid rattles, a step gentler if it is hard to press in.
- **Print the cover again.** A cover made before 1.17 has no catches. Covers are now 7.4 mm deeper inside than the box of tissues, to make room for the lid inside the rim (the Tissue Box Cover is 4.4 mm taller and 4 mm shorter). Covers with very round corners now get a lid too. To try the fit first without a long print, set the box's **Tall** to 1.2 cm and print that short cover with its lid.

Vaseinator is free. If it has made you something you like, you can [buy me a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rickapps).
